title: kate-core: indent after a colon before a hash comment
summary: A Python newline still adds one unit when a hash comment follows a colon. A return with a comment still drops one unit. The test goes in the existing indent tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: indent.rs is a private module of workspace.rs. Its one test module is mod tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Change only ends_with_colon. Use let code = body.split_once('#').map(|(head, _)| head).unwrap_or(body); then matches! on code.trim_end_matches([' ', '\t']).chars().next_back() of Some(':'). Use the array [' ', '\t']. Do not compare a character with a space or a tab by hand. Do not match Option by hand. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not touch python_newline, ends_with_opener, is_comment_line, is_dedent_word, or indent_unit. The existing test python_newline_adds_a_unit_after_a_colon stays green. The test a_colon_before_a_hash_comment_still_indents uses the helper python_inserted and DocumentConfig::default. Four spaces, foo, colon, space, hash, space, note returns a newline and eight spaces. Four spaces, return, space, hash, space, done returns a newline and no spaces. Four spaces, hash, space, note, colon returns a newline and four spaces. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: workspace::indent::tests::a_colon_before_a_hash_comment_still_indents
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. A colon before a hash comment copies the indent only. After the change it adds one unit. A return with a hash comment still drops one unit. A comment line stays at its indent.
